abstraction: Each bundle is its owner's unique selected minimum good plus a nonempty remainder. Per-observer selected-good values, remainder totals, and remainder minima exactly determine all encoded EFX edges. Remainder realizability is relaxed, so UNSAT is sound.
candidate_family: four direct insertions plus every transfer of a source owner's selected minimum good, with host and source independent
meaning: UNSAT proves the selected owner-minimum pair-extraction disjunction for four-agent one-floater EFX states whose four bundles are nonsingletons. SAT must be checked for item-level realizability.
